name: photo-sorter
description: Minimal Action Gateway Toolbelt for Agent Photo Sorter sessions. Prefer publishing this and referencing toolbelt:photo-sorter@v1 from the harness spec.
notes: Photo labeling itself uses Serverless Inference VLMs inside scripts/label.py, not Action Gateway.
Search/fetch are optional helpers when the agent needs place or landmark context.
Create with: python scripts/create_toolbelt.py (requires DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN and pydo).
